sample_sequence: sample a fixed number of frames from a video sequence with optional random offset and stride
sample_linspace_sequence: sample multiple evenly spaced windows from a video sequence and concatenate them into one tensor
crop_image: crop video frames to a target height and width with center cropping or padding if needed
normalize_image: normalize video frame pixel values to 0-1 or -1 to 1 range for model input
tokenize: tokenize raw text strings into word indices using a WordTokenizer and crop or pad to max length
